## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup (no functional change)

- [ ] Build / tooling / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Builds locally (`npm run tauri:build`) with no new warnings or errors.
- [ ] If a new Tauri command was added, the demo/web API stub was updated so the browser-only build still runs.
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in (formatting-only churn, version bumps, or drive-by edits kept out).
- [ ] Version numbers bumped in the usual places if this is a release-bound change.
- [ ] User-facing strings are wired through the i18n layer (English + Spanish) where applicable.
